cookie.label: Login Cookie
cookie.description: The Login cookie you grabbed from an existing session, see the documentation.

po_token_server_url.label: PO Token Server URL
po_token_server_url.description:
The URL to the PO Token server. Can be left as default for most people. 

**Note that this does require you to have the 'YT Music PO Token Generator' addon installed!**

include_videos_in_search.label: Include videos in search results
include_videos_in_search.description: Search YouTube Music videos as well as songs, including covers, remixes and live performances. This does not change radio or library imports.

errors.cookies_expired: Your YouTube Music cookies have expired. Reconfigure this provider with fresh cookies, and close the browser window you exported them from right away.
errors.po_token_server_unreachable: The PO Token server is not reachable. Make sure the YT Music PO Token Generator is installed and running.
